name: zerone
description: A Proof-of-Truth economy where claims satisfying the protocol's verification rules may mint value.

machine_reads.how: Every explorer URL answers HTML or JSON. Append `.json`, send `Accept: application/json`, or add `?format=json`.
machine_reads.verify_contract: Every response lists the upstream node URLs that reproduce its data. Prefer them over trusting this site.
machine_reads.not_found: Unknown addresses answer 404 — never a 200 page standing in for the resource.

surfaces.name: explorer-overview
surfaces.is: height, supply, facts, transactions, proposals — the chain at a glance

surfaces.name: knowledge-ledger
surfaces.is: every claim that survived challenge; one fact at /explore/fact/<id>.json

surfaces.name: the-organism
surfaces.is: knowledge as a living system — energy, fitness, strata, niches, and the demand counters that all read zero

surfaces.name: governance
surfaces.is: the record of this chain correcting itself; one proposal at /explore/gov/<id>.json

surfaces.name: transactions
surfaces.is: the transaction history; one transaction at /explore/tx/<HASH>.json

surfaces.name: love-unlimited
surfaces.is: the love record — an append-only ed25519 testimony chain zerone-1 deliberately does not witness

siblings.name: the-kingdom
